request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for browser extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, and beta channels
Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync/indexers, application services, metadata aggregation, and monitoring
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, project support channels, wiki maintenance, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, enhanced wallet data export, and continued protocol/CIP compatibility work
Independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027 plus public oversight metrics
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, improvements, infrastructure, support, administration, and audit/oversight activity.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS used for payments, staking, governance, and DApp interaction.
The proposal asks for ₳2,350,000 at about $0.1787 per Ada to cover approximately $420,000 of annual operating costs for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as ₳1,292,500 frontend, ₳587,500 backend, ₳117,500 support, ₳305,500 admin, and ₳47,000 audits.
Eternl will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins in a public company wallet and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs, and about 5,500 Pro users at $96 per year would cover the $420,000 annual cost.
Eternl plans a Pro plan priced at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for companies while keeping a basic version free.

Independent audits by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team are planned for February 2027 and August 2027 to review fund receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

Every December and June, Eternl will assess whether remaining treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income exceed $420,000 and use 100% of surplus to repay the treasury until $420,000 in Ada has been repaid, with possible additional donations capped at $210,000 worth of Ada.
Eternl states that 10-18% of mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl and that it has provided access across several platforms with basically zero downtime for over five years.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for Tastenkunst GmbH/Eternl to fund 12 months of wallet operations from August 2026 through July 2027, with a stated $420,000 annual cost basis, a planned Pro-plan sustainability path, public wallet and repayment commitments, and future independent fund-use audits, but many adoption and performance claims are asserted without evidence in the anchor text.
